::: {#exm-identity-function}
#### Identity functions

- Flipping twice is the identity function (@def-identity-function) on $\set{0, 1}^*$:
  $\operatorname{flip}(\operatorname{flip}(s)) = s$ for every $s \in \set{0, 1}^*$,
  as @sol-flip-twice found for $s = 0110$.
- The graph (@def-graph) of $\operatorname{id}_G$ is the relation $B^3$ of @exm-relation-power,
  which relates each element of $G$ to itself.

:::
